# Metaplex Token Metadata

`token_metadata.so` is the Token Metadata program (`metaqbxxUerdq28cj1RbAWkYQm3ybzjb6a8bt518x1s`) as deployed on mainnet-beta, dumped on 8 October 2026 with
`solana program dump metaqbxxUerdq28cj1RbAWkYQm3ybzjb6a8bt518x1s token_metadata.so -u mainnet-beta`.
It only runs in `programs/fade/tests/share_metadata.rs`.
